fk_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseSession_pkey" ON public."CourseSession" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseSession_id_storeId_key" ON public."CourseSession" USING btree (id, "storeId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseSession_storeId_requestKey_requestIndex_key" ON public."CourseSession" USING btree ("storeId", "requestKey", "requestIndex")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CourseSession_teacherMakeupForSessionId_key" ON public."CourseSession" USING btree ("teacherMakeupForSessionId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CoursePointPlan_pkey" ON public."CoursePointPlan" USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CoursePointPlan_id_storeId_key" ON public."CoursePointPlan" USING btree (id, "storeId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "CoursePointPlan_storeId_name_key" ON public."CoursePointPlan" USING btree ("storeId", name)

ledger_check.definition: CHECK (((points > 0) AND ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['GRANT'::text, 'RESERVE'::text, 'RELEASE'::text, 'DEBIT'::text, 'REFUND'::text, 'VOID'::text])) OR (kind ~ '^(DEBIT|RELEASE):[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text) OR (kind ~ '^CORRECT:(RESERVED|ATTENDED|NO_SHOW):(RESERVED|ATTENDED|NO_SHOW):[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text) OR (kind ~ '^CORRECT:CANCELLED:RESERVED:[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text) OR (kind ~ '^(DEBIT|RELEASE|REFUND|RESERVE):USAGE:[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text))))
